fixture: Locally generated 84-page PDF. No document leaves the browser.

findings.flow: Search for “page” after scrolling to the last tool
findings.inputMethods: Composition changes the field immediately. Filtering waits for candidate confirmation. Enter can then open a unique match.

findings.flow: Move from page 1 to 84 with Page numbers open
findings.before: 83 Next page activations while staying in the tool.
findings.after: Tap the page count, enter 84 and choose Go. The starting-number draft remains 17. Dismissal returns to the previous page if no destination was submitted.

checks.canvasLayoutCoverage: 15 screen sizes in both themes at 16px and 32px root text, including 535, 536 and 537px wide landscape phones.
checks.pageJumpDialogCoverage: 19 screen sizes in both themes at 16px and 32px. A recoverable invalid destination, bounds, scroll and reachable controls exercised in every case.
checks.navigation: 176 responsive navigation cases and 176 registered tool selections.
checks.chromiumAndWebKit: Chromium 158 and WebKit 26.6 with touch emulation. An invalid destination, tap and keyboard submission, cancellation, focus return, draft retention, search and rotation passed.
checks.firefox: Firefox 160 desktop at 320px. Page jump, invalid input, keyboard submission, Escape, focus return and previous page passed.
checks.safariSimulator: On an iPhone 17 Pro simulator running iOS 26.2, the isolated shipping page picker accepted a number through the native keypad and navigated. The full app intermittently reloaded during PDF intake, before the picker could be verified end to end. Physical hardware was unavailable.
